materialFindings.finding: The official test:visual command covers one public visual spec instead of the full screenshot-bearing Playwright suite.
Saved visual baselines are runtime-to-runtime snapshots and do not prove direct fidelity against the approved design-source exports.
The public homepage and property-listing visual cases do not supply populated API fixtures, so an error state can satisfy the visual gate.
Material visual differences were observed between approved PUB-01, AUTH-01, and ADM-01 sources and the current saved runtime baselines.

ADM-54 has no recovered historical export. A new owner-authored local HTML/PNG source and runtime comparison exist under DESIGN-DECISION-ADM-54-AUTHOR-001, but explicit Project Owner review is pending and direct historical Figma comparison was not performed.
The Web client build emits a JavaScript chunk around 1.50 MB minified and warns that it exceeds 500 kB; no enforced justified bundle budget is proven.
Live production-parity MongoDB, private storage and scanning, OTP, monitoring, native Ubuntu services, backup/restore, and external security evidence remains unavailable.

decision: Do not claim that all APIs, all 131 screens, production readiness, or the full platform are complete. Continue from the selector and close the post-release assurance graph with real evidence.
